title: Companies Act 2014 ss.160, 161, 166 and 199: the minutes of directors' and general meetings
source: Companies Act 2014 (No. 38 of 2014), ss. 160, 161, 166, 182 and 199 as enacted, read on irishstatutebook.ie 2026-10-09. Later amendments were not read for these sections.

rules.text: The minutes of a directors' meeting give the names of the directors present.
Every resolution and the proceedings of a directors' meeting are entered in the minutes, and so is every appointment of an officer.
Minutes signed by the chairperson of the meeting, or of the next one, are evidence of the proceedings; the minutes carry the chairperson's signature line.
The directors act with a quorum, two unless they fix another number and one for a sole director; the minutes say one was present.
A resolution in writing signed by all the directors is as valid as one passed at a meeting; its record carries every director's signature line.
The minutes of a general meeting record its proceedings and the terms of every resolution.
Minutes are entered in the books as soon as may be after the meeting.
